mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selection_team team JOIN selection_team_member member ON member.team_id=team.id AND member.student_id=#{studentId} WHERE team.id=#{teamId} AND member.member_role='LEADER' AND member.member_status IN ('JOINED','LOCKED') AND team.team_status IN ('FORMING','LOCKED','SELECTING')

SELECT member.student_id AS studentId, student.student_number AS studentNumber, student.student_name AS studentName, member.member_role AS memberRole, member.member_status AS memberStatus, major.major_name AS majorName FROM selection_team_member member JOIN student ON student.id=member.student_id LEFT JOIN major ON major.id=student.major_id WHERE member.team_id=#{teamId} AND member.member_status IN ('JOINED','LOCKED') ORDER BY CASE member.member_role WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, student.student_number
